title: pain001-mcp: ISO 20022 pain.001 and pain.008 payment files (SEPA, cross-border, MT101)
description: ISO 20022 payment initiation for AI agents: generate and validate pain.001 (SEPA credit transfer, cross-border) and pain.008 (SEPA direct debit) files, check IBAN and BIC, validate against the official XSD and the core's scheme rulebook profiles (SEPA SCT/SDD/INST/B2B, UK Bacs/FPS/CHAPS, US ACH/RTP/wire, cross-border and more), convert legacy SWIFT MT101, parse camt.053 statements and pain.002 status reports, migrate records between message editions, and read a validated example corpus of 43 scenarios with provenance, and project a pain.001 file into UK Open Banking, Berlin Group or ISO 20022 element names with a loss report, and check an existing pain.001 or pain.008 file against its XSD, the message rules and scheme profiles. 30 tools, every one with an output schema; errors as data, no stack traces; stdio by default, streamable HTTP and SSE on request; 100% line and branch coverage, mutation-tested handlers, SLSA provenance and signed releases. Ships with the pain001 suite at the suite's version.
